subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `after_compaction` hooks permanently receive a public, deferred current-session `resetSession(reason?)` API once all caller bookkeeping invariants and live proof are complete?
rationale: This is an additive plugin contract with compatibility and lifecycle consequences across built-in and third-party harnesses; code review can identify defects, but only a repository owner can confirm that this is the intended permanent plugin capability.

options.title: Approve the narrow hook API
options.body: Keep the current-session-only, after-compaction-only contract, but require all stale-accounting findings, SDK boundaries, and end-to-end reset proof before merge.

options.title: Keep reset ownership internal
options.body: Remove the public hook API and implement reset behavior only in the owning compaction/session integration until a broader plugin contract is designed.

options.title: Pause for lifecycle design
options.body: Close or pause this branch and define a smaller reset-commit result contract shared by compaction callers before exposing any plugin method.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Keep the current-session-only, after-compaction-only contract, but require all stale-accounting findings, SDK boundaries, and end-to-end reset proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available history across auto-reply, embedded lifecycle, and isolated cron ownership boundaries.
